local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local guiParent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
pcall(function() if gethui then guiParent = gethui() end end)
for _, g in ipairs(guiParent:GetChildren()) do
	if g.Name == "GearGiverGui" then g:Destroy() end
end

local function findGearRemote()
	for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("RemoteFunction") and d.Name == "RemoteFunction" then
			if d:FindFirstAncestor("gear machine chest") then return d end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local mode = "single"
local halfW = (W - 24 - 8) / 2

local function setMode(newMode)
	mode = newMode
	local isMulti = newMode == "multi"

	if isMulti then
		tb1.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 1"
		tb2.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 2"
		tb3.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 3"
		tb4.PlaceholderText = "Gear ID 4"

		TS:Create(btnMulti, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()

		TS:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, MULTI_H)}):Play()

		tb1.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 80); tb1.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34)
		tb2.Visible = false; tb3.Visible = false; tb4.Visible = false
		TS:Create(btnSingle, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 0, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}):Play()
		TS:Create(btnMulti, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 175)}):Play()
		TS:Create(giveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 122)}):Play()
		TS:Create(status, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 166)}):Play()

	end

btnSingle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if mode ~= "single" then setMode("single") end end)
btnMulti.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() if mode ~= "multi" then setMode("multi") end end)

local function giveGear()
	local ids = {}
	for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
		if b.Visible then
			for id in b.Text:gmatch("%d+") do ids[#ids+1] = id end
		end
	end
	if #ids == 0 then
		setStatus("Enter at least one valid Gear ID.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		return
	end
	local remote = findGearRemote()
	if not remote then
		setStatus("Gear remote not found.", Color3.fromRGB(240, 120, 120))
		return
	end
	setStatus("Requesting " .. #ids .. " gear(s)...", Color3.fromRGB(220, 200, 120))
	local okCount = 0
	for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
		local ok = pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("give gear", id) end)
		if ok then okCount += 1 end
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	if okCount == #ids then
		setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. " gear(s)!", Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150))
	else
		setStatus("Requested " .. okCount .. "/" .. #ids .. " gear(s).", Color3.fromRGB(230, 200, 120))
	end
end

giveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(giveGear)
for _, b in ipairs(boxes) do
	b.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then giveGear() end end)
end

setMode("single")

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = main.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
end)

scripts.script:
-- =============================================
-- FOCUS SCRIPT com Rayfield + Aimbot + Botão M1 Flutuante
-- =============================================
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ========== CONFIGURAÇÕES ==========
local FocusEnabled = false
local AimbotEnabled = false
local TargetPlayer = nil
local FocusDistance = 15
local M1Duration = 0.6
local AimbotSmoothness = 0.25

-- Controle do M1
local m1Active = false

-- ========== JANELA ==========
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Focus Script",
    LoadingTitle = "Focus",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Assistente",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = true,
        FolderName = "FocusScript",
        FileName = "FocusConfig"
    },
    KeySystem = false
})

-- ========== ABA MAIN ==========
local MainTab = Window:CreateTab("Main", 4483362458)
MainTab:CreateSection("Focus")

local FocusToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Ativar Focus",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "FocusToggle",
    Callback = function(value)
        FocusEnabled = value
        if FocusEnabled then
            TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
            if not TargetPlayer then
                Rayfield:Notify({Title = "Focus", Content = "Nenhum jogador disponível!", Duration = 3})
                FocusEnabled = false
                FocusToggle:Set(false)
            end
        else
            TargetPlayer = nil
        end
    end
})

MainTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

local AimbotToggle = MainTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Ativar Aimbot (mira na cabeça)",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AimbotToggle",
    Callback = function(value) AimbotEnabled = value end
})

-- ========== ABA SETTINGS ==========
local SettingsTab = Window:CreateTab("Configurações", 4483362458)
SettingsTab:CreateSection("Focus")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Distância acima do alvo",
    Range = {1, 100},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "studs",
    CurrentValue = 15,
    Flag = "FocusDistanceSlider",
    Callback = function(value) FocusDistance = value end
})

SettingsTab:CreateSection("Aimbot")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Suavidade do Aimbot",
    Range = {0, 100},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "%",
    CurrentValue = 25,
    Flag = "AimbotSmoothSlider",
    Callback = function(value) AimbotSmoothness = value / 100 end
})

SettingsTab:CreateSection("M1")

SettingsTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Duração do M1 (tempo colado no alvo)",
    Range = {1, 20},
    Increment = 1,
    Suffix = "x0.1s",
    CurrentValue = 6, -- 0.6s
    Flag = "M1DurationSlider",
    Callback = function(value) M1Duration = value / 10 end
})

-- ========== FUNÇÕES ==========

function getRandomTarget()
    local validTargets = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and char.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                table.insert(validTargets, player)
            end
        end
    end
    if #validTargets > 0 then
        return validTargets[math.random(1, #validTargets)]
    end
    return nil
end

function getLocalHRP()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end
    return nil
end

-- =============================================
-- FUNÇÃO SEGURA PARA OLHAR PARA UM PONTO
-- (Evita NaN quando a distância é 0)
-- =============================================
function safeLookAt(fromPos, toPos)
    local diff = fromPos - toPos
    -- Se os pontos forem praticamente iguais, evita NaN
    if diff.Magnitude < 0.05 then
        return CFrame.new(fromPos)
    end
    return CFrame.new(fromPos, toPos)
end

-- =============================================
-- M1 REAL DO MOUSE
-- =============================================
function fireRealM1()
    pcall(function()
        if mouse1click then mouse1click() end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
        local x, y = mouse.X, mouse.Y
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1)
        task.wait(0.03)
        VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)
    end)
end

-- =============================================
-- M1: COLA A HITBOX NO ALVO
-- =============================================
function doM1Teleport()
    if m1Active then return end

    local myHRP = getLocalHRP()
    if not myHRP then return end

    -- Garante um alvo
    local targetChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar or not targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or targetChar.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        targetChar = TargetPlayer and TargetPlayer.Character
    end
    if not targetChar then return end

    local targetHRP = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHRP then return end

    m1Active = true

    -- Cola no alvo: fica LIGEIRAMENTE acima (1 stud) para evitar NaN
    -- e mantém a direção do próprio alvo
    local targetPos = targetHRP.Position
    local myNewPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)

    -- Usa a própria orientação do alvo, virado pra ele
    myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(myNewPos) * (targetHRP.CFrame - targetHRP.CFrame.Position)

    myHRP.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    myHRP.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero

    -- Dispara o M1 real
    task.wait(0.05)
    fireRealM1()

    -- Após o tempo configurado, sai do modo "colado"
    task.delay(M1Duration, function()
        m1Active = false
    end)
end

-- =============================================
-- FOCUS (sem paralizar)
-- =============================================
function updateFocus()
    if not FocusEnabled or not TargetPlayer then return end

    local targetChar = TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        return
    end

    local targetHRP = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHum = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if not targetHRP or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
        TargetPlayer = getRandomTarget()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = getLocalHRP()
    if not myHRP then return end

    local targetPos = targetHRP.Position

    if m1Active then
        -- Modo M1: cola no alvo (1 stud acima pra evitar NaN)
        local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        -- Mantém a rotação do alvo, mas não usa lookAt pra não dar NaN
        myHRP.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPos) * (targetHRP.CFrame - targetHRP.CFrame.Position)
    else
        -- Modo normal: fica na distância configurada acima, olhando pro alvo
        local newPos = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, FocusDistance, 0)
        myHRP.CFrame = safeLookAt(newPos, targetPos)
    end

    myHRP.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    myHRP.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

-- =============================================
-- AIMBOT
-- =============================================
function updateAimbot()
    if not AimbotEnabled or not TargetPlayer then return end

    local targetChar = TargetPlayer.Character
    if not targetChar then return end

    local targetHead = targetChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not targetHead then return end

    local headPos = targetHead.Position
    local camPos = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local desiredCFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, headPos)

    if AimbotSmoothness <= 0 then
        Camera.CFrame = desiredCFrame
    else
        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desiredCFrame, 1 - AimbotSmoothness)
    end
end

scripts.script:
--!strict

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local BOMB_NAME: string = "BombMissile"
local TOGGLE_KEY: Enum.KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.X
local SPEED: number = 300
local SPRINT_MULT: number = 2.5
local TURN_SENS: number = 0.003
local PITCH_CLAMP: number = math.rad(85)

local INVERT_AD: boolean = true
local BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET: number = math.rad(90)

local tracked: BasePart? = nil
local bodyVelocity: BodyVelocity? = nil
local active: boolean = false
local yaw: number = 0
local pitch: number = 0
local heartbeatConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
local mouseMoveConn: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

local keys: { [Enum.KeyCode]: boolean } = {}

local function findBomb(): BasePart?
	local obj = workspace:FindFirstChild(BOMB_NAME, true)
	if not obj then return nil end
	if obj:IsA("BasePart") then return obj end
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		return obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
	end
	return nil
end

local function ensureThrust(part: BasePart): BodyVelocity
	local existing = part:FindFirstChild("NoraPilot") :: BodyVelocity?
	if existing then return existing end
	local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bv.Name = "NoraPilot"
	bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
	bv.P = 10000
	bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bv.Parent = part
	return bv
end

local function cleanup()
	if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
		bodyVelocity:Destroy()
	end
	bodyVelocity = nil
	tracked = nil
	active = false
	keys = {}
	if heartbeatConn then heartbeatConn:Disconnect() heartbeatConn = nil end
	if mouseMoveConn then mouseMoveConn:Disconnect() mouseMoveConn = nil end
	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
	if LocalPlayer.Character then
		local head = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
		if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
			Camera.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or head
		end
	end
end

local function start()
	tracked = findBomb()
	if not tracked then
		print("бомбы нет")
		return
	end

	bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
	active = true
	keys = {}

	local cf = tracked.CFrame
	yaw = math.atan2(-cf.LookVector.X, -cf.LookVector.Z)
	pitch = math.asin(cf.LookVector.Y)

	Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	print("пилот на " .. tracked.Name)

	heartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
		if not active then return end
		if not tracked or not tracked.Parent then
			cleanup()
			return
		end
		if not bodyVelocity or not bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity = ensureThrust(tracked)
		end

		local rot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch, yaw, 0)
		local forward = -rot.LookVector
		local right = rot.RightVector
		local up = Vector3.yAxis

		local adSign: number = if INVERT_AD then -1 else 1

		local move = Vector3.zero
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.W] then move += forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.S] then move -= forward end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.D] then move += right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.A] then move -= right * adSign end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.Space] then move += up end
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] then move -= up end

		local spd = SPEED
		if keys[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift] then spd *= SPRINT_MULT end

		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			move = move.Unit * spd
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = move

		local bombRot = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(pitch + BOMB_PITCH_OFFSET, yaw, 0)
		tracked.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position) * bombRot
		Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(tracked.Position - forward * 12 + up * 4, tracked.Position + forward * 10)
	end)

	mouseMoveConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if not active then return end
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		if not UserInputService.MouseBehavior then return end
		yaw -= input.Delta.X * TURN_SENS
		pitch -= input.Delta.Y * TURN_SENS
		pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -PITCH_CLAMP, PITCH_CLAMP)
	end)

	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gpe: boolean)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
		if active then
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
			cleanup()
			print("вышел")
		else
			start()
		end
		return
	end
	if active then
		keys[input.KeyCode] = true
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
	keys[input.KeyCode] = false
end)
